Action.description: What a workflow suggests doing. Under an approve policy it is held until a person approves it: a held result carries action_status, and loses action until it is approved.

verb.description: Known values: reroute, swap. A reader skips a verb it does not know.
verb.title: Verb

Action.title: Action

Entity.description: What the result is about. type is pass or link for a pass or link, or the entity a sum is by (antenna, ...).

track.description: A pass's ground track, when known.
track.title: Track

Entity.title: Entity

Value.description: The output columns, by name: p10, p50 and p90 for a column with quantiles.
Value.title: Value

description: One result of a run, as the body of each OTLP log record GET /predictions/feed returns (attribute constellation.schema = constellation.item/v2), and as GET /predictions answers a run's or a lane's results. An entity at a time (or over a span) with a value, the per-node ledger that explains it, and the version that produced it. series, severity and action are optional facets. Their string values are open: a reader handles the known values each lists and does not reject a new one. A reader acts on an action only when there is no action_status or action_status is approved; any other or unknown status is held.

action_id.description: A held action, the same on every run that suggests the same verb on the same entity to the same target.
action_id.title: Action Id

action_status.description: Where a held action stands. Known values: pending, approved, rejected. Only approved may be acted on: any other or unknown value is held.
action_status.title: Action Status

decision_id.description: A person's decision on the held action, present once it is approved or rejected. It changes only when a new decision is made, so a reader acts once per decision_id.
decision_id.title: Decision Id

explain.description: The ledger: each node's value, unit and source behind the result.
explain.title: Explain

model_release_id.description: The model release that produced a lane's result.
model_release_id.title: Model Release Id

note.description: What the item's action comes to, as a sentence for a person: the swap to make, or why there is none to act on (no backup pass, waiting for approval, rejected, shown for review).
note.title: Note

quantity.description: What a lane result's value measures, such as snr_db or rx_power_dbm.
quantity.title: Quantity

series.description: Values over the result's span, in time order.
series.title: Series

severity.description: Absent means info. Known values: info, warning, critical; read any other as info.
severity.title: Severity

unit.description: The unit of a lane result's value, such as dB or dBm.
unit.title: Unit

until.description: The end of the result's span, for a result over a span.
until.title: Until

workflow_version.description: The workflow version that produced a workflow's result.
workflow_version.title: Workflow Version

title: Workflow result
